readme.summary: Well-structured README with excellent clarity and quick start, but lacks detailed configuration documentation and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section despite common issues like terminal compatibility, font rendering problems, or performance on different systems that users might encounter

injection_risks.description: The va_system function uses the system function with a string that is constructed using user input, which can lead to command injection attacks.
The c_die function uses the vfprintf function with a format string that may contain user-controlled data, which can lead to format string vulnerabilities.

critical_findings: Command injection vulnerability in va_system function
Format string vulnerability in c_die function
security.summary: The cmatrix program has several security concerns, including command injection and format string vulnerabilities, but it does not appear to handle sensitive data or have any major input validation issues.

common_complaints: Japanese/Unicode character support incomplete and buggy
Undocumented features and hidden key combinations
Lack of documentation for existing features
praise_themes: Users still interested in the project
sentiment.summary: The cmatrix project shows signs of abandonment with no releases since 2019, unresolved feature requests, multiple bugs in core functionality (Unicode support), and minimal maintainer engagement despite consistent user interest.

communication.summary: The maintainer provides generally helpful and clear responses, handles repeated questions patiently, and encourages new contributors, but sometimes lacks technical depth in explanations.

maintenance.summary: The cmatrix project appears to be abandoned with no development activity, issue triage, or contributor engagement for at least 6 months.

changelog.summary: The changelog is incomplete and lacks essential information, redirecting users to an external link for details.

governance.summary: The cmatrix project has a documented decision process and multiple maintainers, but lacks a clear succession plan and contributor ladder.
